class.name: CbSheet
class.brief_description: A rules sheet: a [code].cbsheet[/code] file, plain text, held by a [CbRules] node.
class.description: The extension reads and writes [code].cbsheet[/code] files itself: the file is the sheet's [member text], whole, nothing more (no header, no Godot markup), so any text editor, diff and tool reads it as it is. Set on a [CbRules] node as a resource, Godot knows which scenes use it: one moved or renamed in the FileSystem dock keeps working, and a pack carries it with its scene. In the editor a sheet opens in the Sheet screen (double-click it, or click a node's sheet): its words coloured, the names the server's mods declare offered while typing, a line with a mistake tinted (put the caret on it to read why). What is typed is the sheet's at once; Ctrl+S saves it with the scene. What a sheet may say: docs/sheets.md and docs/looks.md (Rules sheets).

members.member: The sheet's lines. Setting it tells every [CbRules] that holds the sheet to build its rules again.
